exposure: conservative surgeries of local resection of the mass with uterine reconstruction
adjuvant endocrine therapy (megestrol acetate or triptorelin)
cohort: The study included five patients aged 28-36 years old with low-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma who desired childbearing.
finding: Fertility-sparing treatment, combined with adjuvant endocrine therapy, is considered suitable for selected young low-grade ESS patients, especially those with lesions having clear borderlines.
mod_finding: Three patients who underwent fertility-sparing treatment had uncomplicated pregnancies and received cesarean delivery of a liveborn neonate.
